thread:
Maya (Content): kicking off launch planning for LocalLaunchKit (OSS) — deliverables: short launch post, reproducible bench blurb, 50m webinar + 30m hands-on lab, and a 3-tweet developer thread. :sparkles:
Jon (DevRel): love it. lab should be 20-30m runnable with a clear checklist + expected outputs. repo structure proposal: /quickstart, /bench, /examples, /lab-notebook, /faq.
Rita (Product Marketing): benchmark narrative must be honest and reproducible: p90 @256 & @512 tokens, tokens/sec, and a cost-per-request delta vs hosted. keep visuals to one simple chart.
Diego (SRE): I'll run bench matrix on a small GPU and a CPU-sim node and upload CSV + tiny PNG. bench command to show in README:
```
RW_KEY=... ./tools/bench --model llm-lite --seq 512 --concurrency 3
```
Jon (DevRel): include a minimal Docker and k8s example for the lab. also a quick-check script that prints latency and tokens/sec so attendees can confirm success.
Sam (Growth): landing page must use utm=local_launch_kit and feed into HubSpot. promo plan: announcement, 2 reminders, day-of paid push, and a post-webinar nurture with repo links. need 2 short exec quotes and one customer blurb (if available).
Maya (Content): draft headline idea: "LocalLaunchKit: a lightweight starter to run LLMs locally and on private infra". I'll draft blog + tweet thread by Tue EOD.
Rita (Product Marketing): speakers: Jon (DevRel) + Rita (PMM) + Diego (Ops). agenda: 20m demo, 15m bench walk, 10m Q&A, 30m optional lab. record and add repo CI to publish artifacts.
webinar-bot: Reminder: schedule webinar >= 21 days out with template "webinar-standard".
Diego (SRE): action items: bench CSV, docker image, single-file k8s manifest, telemetry snippet. will drop artifacts into /bench tomorrow AM.
Sam (Growth): inbound routing: registrants -> list "local_launch_regs"; attended -> tag local_launch:attended; >2 email opens -> mark warm and notify AEs via slack #sales-inbound.
Maya (Content): demo snippet for blog (short):
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/local-launch-kit:latest
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this repo"}'
```
Jon (DevRel): will add troubleshooting section: common docker issues, CPU fallback tips, and a short quantization checklist.
Rita (Product Marketing): timeline: week 1 repo + draft blog, week 2 bench + assets, week 3 webinar + promos. let's do a dry-run one week before.
Maya (Content): owners recap: Maya -> blog + tweets; Jon -> repo + lab guide; Diego -> bench + artifacts; Rita -> bench narrative + speaker notes; Sam -> landing page + HubSpot. I'll assemble a short launch checklist when first drafts land.
Jon (DevRel): starting repo scaffold now, will push initial commit today.
Diego (SRE): bench runs scheduled tomorrow morning; will post results here.
Maya (Content): thanks all — keeping this thread as source-of-truth. any blockers?
Rita (Product Marketing): none from me. excited to get this out. :rocket:
